ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The substrate in the figure contains an R1-substituted C=N-O fragment; the carbon in this C=N is also connected to an adjacent carbon bearing R2. N is connected to O by a single bond, and this O is further connected to the acetal/hemiacetal-like carbon on the right, forming a C-C-N-O-C five-membered ring skeleton; the carbon on the right is simultaneously connected to OH and OR. The curved arrows in the figure indicate electron rearrangement related to the right-side OH/OR, pointing in the direction of forming a carbonyl and undergoing leaving/proton transfer. Reasoning: According to the arrow pushing, the OH-bearing carbon is oxidized/rearranged into a carbonyl carbon, and OR is removed as a leaving group or via proton transfer; the C-C-N-O-C connectivity within the ring remains unchanged, and R1 and R2 are represented by the [*] wildcard. Therefore the product is a five-membered-ring imino carbonate/oxazolone-like structure, corresponding to the SMILES [*]C(C1[*])=NOC1=O.

method.method_draft: First describe the image structure and label atoms: R1-C(=N-O)-C(R2)-C(OH)(OR) with the O from N-O incorporated in the cyclic tether to the acetal carbon. Follow the depicted electron flow: convert the OH-bearing carbon into a carbonyl, eliminate/proton-transfer the OR group, and keep the C-C-N-O-C ring connectivity. Replace R1 and R2 by [*] wildcards, then write the resulting five-membered cyclic imino carbonate/oxazolone-like product as the SMILES [*]C(C1[*])=NOC1=O.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中底物含有一个 R1 取代的 C=N-O 片段；该 C=N 中的碳还连接到一个带 R2 的相邻碳。N 与 O 单键相连，该 O 又连到右侧的缩醛/半缩醛样碳，形成 C-C-N-O-C 的五元环骨架；右侧碳同时连接 OH 和 OR。图中的弯箭头表示右侧 OH/OR 相关电子重排，指向形成羰基并发生离去/质子转移的方向。推理：按照箭头推动，OH-bearing carbon 被氧化/重排为羰基碳，OR 作为离去或经质子转移被去除；环内的 C-C-N-O-C 连接关系保持不变，R1 和 R2 用 [*] 通配符表示。因此产物是五元环的 imino carbonate/oxazolone-like 结构，对应 SMILES 为 [*]C(C1[*])=NOC1=O。

Encode this neutral cyclic graph in SMILES with ring index 1 and wildcard R groups, yielding [*]C(C1[*])=NOC1=O.
